jane_acme: Hey — heads up: our mobile app (v4.2.1) started returning 429s around 2026-03-10 02:12 UTC. Dashboard showed monthly credits = 0 but billing page shows remaining quota. Impacting live users. SDK v1.8. Can you investigate?

maria: on it — can you paste the SDK logs or an example request/response? Do you see any X-RW- headers in the response?

jane_acme: paste from device debug log (redacted):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-quota-remaining: 0
x-rw-quota-reset: 1770003600
x-rw-burst-used: 12000
content-type: application/json
{"error":"quota_exhausted", "request_id":"rid-9876"}
```
Note: device had flaky cell network; app may have retried in background.

raj: that x-rw-burst-used number is high for a single session — looks like retries are causing multiple token draws. The mobile SDK exponential retries could be re-opening streams and getting charged per new connection. Do you have a session_id or example request_id?

jane_acme: session_id: abc123, request_id: rid-9876. Our SDK background sync will retry uploads when connectivity returns — toggling airplane mode reproduces it locally.

maria: steps to repro will help us confirm client vs server: please list concise repro steps and any verbose SDK logs. If it's client-side we can push an SDK patch to debounce background sync and add idempotency headers.

jane_acme: repro steps we used: 1) install app v4.2.1 (SDK 1.8). 2) Start a streaming upload. 3) Toggle airplane mode during upload. 4) Restore connectivity quickly. 5) Observe repeated reconnects and multiple token draws, then 429s. Verbose logs attached in support ticket.

ops-bot: Edge log snippet for org=acme_corp at 2026-03-10T02:12:14Z: request_id=rid-9876 tokens_charged=45 retry_count=6 bucket_balance_before=300 bucket_balance_after=255
Note: charges logged per incoming connection; no dedup by idempotency header observed for this stream.

raj: OK — looks like both sides: (a) client is re-establishing connections aggressively on flaky networks and (b) edge currently charges per connection without tying to an idempotency/session marker. We should treat this as a quota accounting edge-case rather than a billing UI bug.

maria: action plan: (1) billing: temporary manual top-up for ACME to unblock users; (2) devex: hotfix SDK to debounce background sync + emit an `x-rw-idempotency-key` for long-lived sessions; (3) runtime: patch edge to prefer idempotency/session markers for in-flight reconnects so repeated reconnects don't double-charge; (4) follow up with ACME with mitigation steps. Raj/ops — can you own the runtime change and quick mitigation?

raj: I’ll take the runtime change. Short-term mitigation: increase per-connection min-burst allowance for mobile SDK tenant for 24h to reduce 429 impact while we deploy the fix. Also adding server-side idempotency check for recent request_ids should reduce double-counting.

jane_acme: Thanks — manual top-up would be huge. We need to keep production users online. I can provide a sample device trace and exact SDK log bundle.

maria: filing billing ticket now and adding notes + attached logs. Will request temporary top-up. Will also create a small playbook for customers to mitigate (force close app to stop retries, disable background sync temporarily). :handshake:

ops-bot: Billing ticket created: #BILL-4321 assigned to billing_ops. Runtime task queued: INFR-7892. SDK hotfix planned on branch `mobile-debounce-1.8`.
